Name: Gradient Hair Colors (FS Addon)
Author: spacechase0
Description:
Get multi-colored hair with FS hair styles.

Just do `dyehair hue1 saturation1 value1 hue2 saturation2 value2` in the SMAPI console once you load the same. It will set the current hairstyle's color to that. (FS hairstyles only.)

In multiplayer, colors are per-hairstyle, not per-player, due to Fashion Sense limitations. Meaning two players having the same hairstyle can't have different colors.

Make sure your hair is set to white in the FS UI.

[b][size=5]Install[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url]..
[*]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[b][size=5]Use[/size][/b]
Use the following command once you load your save:

`dyehair hue1 saturation1 value1 hue2 saturation2 value2`

Use an online color picker to figure out the colors you want. If you want them to blend the other way, just switch the 1 and 2 values.

Make sure your hair is set to white in the FS UI.

[b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b]
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5.5+ on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.
